$comment: Test build variants (EDR test-build-variants). Each is patches/series plus an explicit list of test-only hooks, built only by a workflow_dispatch of build-macos with test_variant set, and never releasable: check-release fails any artifact carrying seclabTestBuild or a hook marker. Adding a variant or a hook needs a security review round recorded in `review`. A hook's `target` is the artifact it must end up in (desktop or reh); its `marker` is a string literal its code emits, which the build and the harness require in `bundle` (the built file its code lands in, relative to the app root); the marker is never written into product.json, which the build inlines elsewhere.

containment.description: Rogue-REH containment probes (RPC lockdown): the tab's REH loads the probe payload once the harness stages an armed run in the tab.

agentic-browser.description: Increment 2 (patch 0017): drives the browser tool's own network resolution without a model, so a probe can measure where a model-chosen URL is fetched from. The hook is written against the series WITHOUT 0017, so it applies both on main (the U baseline) and on the agentic branch (the fixed build). Valid as a measurement of the tool only in a seclab+ tab window, with no sandbox restrictions, against a non-localhost target; see the hook's comment.
